title: The Time The RAF Dropped Cats By Parachute
description:
Operation Cat Drop is the name given to the delivery of cats, equipment and supplies by the Royal Air Force to remote regions of the then-British colony of Sarawak, on Borneo, in 1960. The cats were flown out of Singapore and delivered in crates dropped by parachute as part of a program to curb an infestation of rats that were destroying crops. It has been suggested that the rats multiplied because insecticides such as DDT had killed many local cats, but this has not been confirmed. The operation was reported as a success at the time. Newspaper reports mention only 23 cats, while some unreliable later accounts claim as many as 14,000.

Source: Wikipedia, 'Operation Cat Drop'.
